tooltip.singulo_arsenal.explorer.helmet: Vision key (default V): 10s night vision, 30s cooldown.
tooltip.singulo_arsenal.explorer.chestpl: Iron-level protection, high durability; repair with Steel Plates.
tooltip.singulo_arsenal.explorer.legging: Prevents freezing from building up while worn.
tooltip.singulo_arsenal.explorer.boots: Walk on powder snow; subtract 3 blocks from fall distance.
tooltip.singulo_arsenal.catalytic.helmet: Displays the matching chestplate's repair reserve.
tooltip.singulo_arsenal.catalytic.chestp: After 10s out of combat, repairs 1 durability/s. A carried cartridge supplies 256 points.
tooltip.singulo_arsenal.catalytic.leggin: Extends the matching chestplate's repair to all worn catalytic armor.
tooltip.singulo_arsenal.catalytic.boots: Outside lava, caps remaining burn time at 2 seconds. No lava immunity.
tooltip.singulo_arsenal.inertial.helmet: Displays impact, overload, and the reservoir armor's FE.
tooltip.singulo_arsenal.inertial.chestpl: 100 FE reduces knockback by 60%. Collects impact from hits (max 100); overload disables for 5s.
tooltip.singulo_arsenal.inertial.legging: Dodge key (default Z): 20 impact + 2,000 FE, grounded only, 1.5s cooldown. Collects impact alone (max 40).
tooltip.singulo_arsenal.inertial.boots: 200 FE halves fall damage; recovers impact from falls of at least 6 blocks.
tooltip.singulo_arsenal.boundary.helmet: Displays shield points, duration, cooldown, and chestplate FE.
tooltip.singulo_arsenal.boundary.chestpl: Barrier key (default B): 20,000 FE + 100 FE/t, absorbs 16 damage for 3s, 60s cooldown.
tooltip.singulo_arsenal.boundary.legging: Extends the matching chestplate's barrier duration to 5 seconds.
tooltip.singulo_arsenal.boundary.boots: While the matching barrier is active, reduces fall damage and knockback by 75%.
tooltip.singulo_arsenal.charge: Charge: hold and sneak-use an energy output face.
message.singulo_arsenal.overloaded: Inertial overload: impact control disabled for 5 seconds.
message.singulo_arsenal.dodge_unavailabl: Dodge needs ground, 20 impact and 2,000 leg FE; unavailable during overload or cooldown.
hud.singulo_arsenal.impact: Inertial | Impact %s | Dodge %s FE | Stabilizer %s FE
